name: Cult of the Black Grail

variants.name: Cult of the Black Grail (base list)

specialRules.name: Infection Markers
specialRules.text: Weapons with the INFECTION MARKERS keyword place INFECTION MARKERS instead of BLOOD MARKERS, placed exactly like BLOOD MARKERS. A model can carry up to 6 INFECTION and up to 6 BLOOD MARKERS at once. An opponent spends them exactly like BLOOD MARKERS (modify Success/Injury Rolls, buy a Bloodbath) and may mix both kinds on one roll or Bloodbath. Rules that remove BLOOD MARKERS cannot remove INFECTION MARKERS unless they say so. The Infection Spreads: when a model that has 1+ INFECTION MARKERS is Activated, add 1 more INFECTION MARKER to it before it takes any Action (up to the cap of 6).

specialRules.name: Morale
specialRules.text: Opponents add -1 DICE to all their Morale Checks, unless they are Court of the Seven-Headed Serpent or Cult of the Black Grail.

specialRules.name: Plague Knight Ranks
specialRules.text: Each Plague Knight may buy one Rank: Plague Almoner (10), Knight Companion of the Fly (5), Knight of the Rotten Cross (5, Limit 1).

variants.name: The Great Hunger
variants.changes: A Matagot Hag leads swarms of Ravenous: no Lord of Tumours, Corpse Guards, Grail Thralls, Heralds or Amalgam; Plague Knights become 0-2 Butcher Knights, Corpse Guards return as 0-2 Desiccated Husks, 0-3 Cradle Thralls for Glory, 0-2 Gregori Gula, Great Maw at 1,000+; its own armoury (replaces the base armoury) with Hunger Strains; each Turn pick a Hunger effect that turns INFECTION MARKERS on your own models into a resource.

specialRules.name: Eternal Appetence
specialRules.text: At the start of each Turn choose one effect for the Turn. Agonised Churning: when Activating a friendly model within 8" of the Hag with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS, you may move 2 of them onto an enemy within 1" (not ARTIFICIAL/DEMONIC). Ruinous Masticating: put 1 INFECTION MARKER on each other friendly model within 8" of the Hag; this Turn the opponent cannot spend INFECTION MARKERS of your models with 2+ of them to penalise their Melee Attacks. Spasmodic Wretching: same marker placement; Ranged Attacks targeting your models with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS get -1 DICE this Turn. Vile Craving: when Activating a friendly model within 8" of the Hag with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS, you may remove 2 and move it up to half its Movement (max 4") straight toward the nearest enemy.

specialRules.name: Butcher Knights
specialRules.text: 0-2 Plague Knights on 32/40mm bases with the Ravenous Infection ACTION for free; they take Great Hunger ranks (Butcher King 10, Companion of the Feast 5, Twin Cleavers 5) instead of the normal ranks.

specialRules.name: Cradle of Filth
specialRules.text: 0-3 Cradle Thralls: Ravenous with INFILTRATOR costing 2 Glory and no ducats; they do not count toward Maximum Field Strength.

specialRules.name: Desiccated Husks
specialRules.text: 0-2 Corpse Guards as Desiccated Husks: melee gains CRITICAL; Bodyguard replaced by More Worm Than Man.

specialRules.name: Excruciating Hunger
specialRules.text: Cannot have Beelzebub's Axe, Black Grail Shields, Bolt-Action Rifles, Blunderbusses, Compound Eyes Helmets, Corruption Belchers, Gas Grenades, Infested Rifles, Machine Guns, Musical Instruments, Muskets, Pistols, Troop Flags or Viscera Cannons.

specialRules.name: Spawn of Gluttony
specialRules.text: Must include 1 Matagot Hag; no Lord of Tumours, Corpse Guards, Grail Thralls, Heralds or Amalgam.

specialRules.name: Hunger Strains
specialRules.text: Any model may have 1 Strain (Ravenous up to 3), bought at recruitment; permanent. Strains are listed in this variant's armoury with the 'Strain' stipulation.
